description: Find the Aviado id for a supplement name, exactly (no fuzzy matching). Answers with matches[0] = the identity: vocabulary_exact, or user_intent for salt/form names ('magnesium citrate' -> magnesium, with a form note). A name Aviado does not hold may be answered with a naming-model suggestion (match_type naming_slm_suggestion, identity false); confirm it with the user before using its id. Family names ('lithium') and confirm-only names return needs_confirmation with the members or candidates in candidates. Each match carries entity_type, regulatory_status and recommendable. Use mode='supplement_retail' only for raw retail product titles. Pass the confirmed canonical_id to the other supplement tools.

mode.description: Explicit routing mode; retail titles require supplement_retail

query.description: Supplement identity or raw retail product title

name: search_supplements
title: Find a supplement
